added.title: Senior/Lead Research Engineer (Foundation Models)
added.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters Labs builds and ships custom models for professional workflows requiring fiduciary-grade AI. The Thomson LLM family was developed by training leading open-weight models on decades of authoritative Thomson Reuters content, with thousands of hours of subject-matter-expert input. Owning the model layer is how we earn trust in the most regulated, highest-stakes professional workflows. See the Thomson 1.0 Technical Report on Hugging Face for more on the latest model release.

Our Research Engineers Build The Systems That Train, Evaluate And Run The Thomson Models, And Work Closely With Research Scientists So That New Algorithms, Rewards And Evaluations Can Be Tested Quickly And At Scale. We Are Hiring At Senior And Lead Level Across Two Areas Of Emphasis. In Your Application, Please Tell Us Which One Fits You Best

Large-scale RL training: architecting and optimising infrastructure for training agentic Mixture-of-Experts models above 300 billion parameters with reinforcement learning, asynchronously and at long context, while the models interact with tools and agent harnesses.
Evaluation engineering: building, scaling and optimising the evaluation suite and leaderboard that run Thomson evaluations as new releases and product integrations arrive.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the systems behind Thomson training, evaluation and experimentation, and keep them reliable as the models and their adoption grow.
Profile and optimise for cost, latency and GPU utilisation without sacrificing quality, and document the trade-offs for the wider team.

Root-cause hard numerical, distributed and performance problems across training frameworks, inference engines and evaluation code.

Work directly with the training and evaluation pods to get new model releases trained, evaluated and live.
Contribute to Thomson's production footing, including the ISO 27001 compliance path.
Set standards for code quality, testing and reproducibility.
At Lead level: own the architecture of your area, plan delivery and staffing with research leads, and mentor engineers.

Required Qualifications

MSc or PhD in computer science, machine learning or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
Strong software engineering practice, including large-scale distributed systems and the ability to work fluently in large open-source codebases.
Experience keeping research or production systems reliable under real load, and debugging distributed systems and incidents.

Experience working closely with researchers and cross-functional stakeholders to turn research ideas and requirements into scalable systems.
Depth in at least one area of emphasis:
Large-scale RL training: multi-node GPU training with PyTorch and Megatron-Core, FSDP/DTensor or DeepSpeed; parallelism strategies (tensor, pipeline, context, expert) and their trade-offs for MoE and long-context models; LLM inference engines (vLLM, SGLang); GPU profiling (memory, NCCL, CUDA graphs).
Evaluation engineering: building, scaling and optimising evaluation suites for LLMs, with examples of the impact your work had.

For Lead level: 3+ years of professional experience in your area and a record of leading complex technical projects end to end and mentoring engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or extending RL post-training frameworks (NeMo-RL, verl, OpenRLHF, TRL), especially asynchronous or non-colocated designs.
Familiarity with evaluation frameworks such as Inspect, Harbor or lm-evaluation-harness.
Experience with distributed runtimes and orchestration (Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm) on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
Significant contributions to vLLM, Megatron, PyTorch or similar open-source projects.
Familiarity with AI-assisted coding and using coding agents at scale.

Even if you don't have all of the above requirements, we encourage you to apply to explore a mutual fit!

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Our use of AI within the recruitment process Thomson Reuters utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI) to support parts of our global recruitment process. Unless you opt-out, our AI system will assess the information provided by you and compare it to the requirements listed for the role, and present the result to our recruitment personnel for further review. The AI system acts as a supporting tool, but there is always a human making the decision if you will be considered for the role.

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $118,400 USD - $219,800 USD. For Ontario, Canada, the base compensation range for this role is $100,000 CAD - $145,000 CAD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

This job posting will close 03/31/2027.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. added.description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen, permanent resident, Asylee, or Refugee.

Export Control/ITAR: Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Please review the job details below.

This position requires an active U.S. Government Security Clearance at the TS/SCI with CI poly
level.

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Software Engineer to integrate secure chatbot and AI assistant capabilities into existing geospatial intelligence, analytics, visualization, and mission-support tools. You will help analysts discover data, navigate applications, and complete approved workflows using natural language. The role requires strong software engineering skills, practical LLM experience, and an understanding of secure, usable AI in mission environments.

Responsibilities

Integrate AI chatbots and assistants into existing geospatial, analytics, visualization, and mission applications.
Build natural-language workflows for data discovery, application navigation, visualization generation, and approved actions.
Implement LLM patterns such as prompt orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and conversation context.
Connect AI services to REST APIs, data catalogs, search platforms, knowledge graphs, geospatial services, notebooks, and dashboards.
Develop reusable backend services and frontend components that make AI assistance simple for analysts to use.
Enforce identity, entitlements, and data-access policies; provide citations, provenance, audit records, and clear system limitations.
Test and evaluate AI quality, safety, latency, and usability, including protections against prompt injection, data leakage, and unauthorized actions.
Deploy and operate AI services in Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift, including restricted or disconnected environments, and collaborate with technical and customer teams.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, data science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production applications or services.
Hands-on experience integrating generative AI or LLMs into production software applications using patterns such as RAG, embeddings, vector search, function calling, or agent workflows.
Strong Python skills and experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Go, C++, or another modern language.
Experience building REST APIs or microservices and using Git, automated testing, CI/CD, and Agile development practices.
Experience integrating enterprise data sources and applying secure identity, authorization, and data-protection controls.
Willingness to work 75% or as needed in a SCIF environment in Herndon, VA; Denver, CO; or St. Louis, MO.
U.S. Person with an active TS/SCI with CI poly, or the ability to obtain the required clearance and polygraph.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building chatbot interfaces with React, TypeScript, or comparable web frameworks and applying usability practices.
Experience with AI orchestration frameworks, model gateways, MCP-compatible services, or agent-to-tool integration.
Experience deploying commercial, open-source, or locally hosted LLMs in cloud, on-premises, classified, air-gapped, or disconnected environments.
Experience with vector search, Elasticsearch, knowledge graphs, GIS, imagery, geospatial applications, or other mission-critical systems.
Experience with AI safety controls, human-in-the-loop approvals, model monitoring, evaluation, GPU workloads, or model serving.
Experience with containers and Kubernetes; Red Hat OpenShift experience is preferred.

added.description:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As an Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II on the team, you will be responsible for:

Lead the implementation of AI-enabled workflow applications and agentic solutions to enhance automation and decision support.
Lead solution design and delivery in secure environments, ensuring alignment with clearance requirements and enterprise data governance standards.
Lead client engagement and communication efforts by facilitating requirement-gathering sessions, shaping solution direction with stakeholders, translating business needs into technical priorities, and directing peers and junior team members to ensure aligned, high-quality delivery.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively with organizational intelligence programs and differentiated strategies to win in their chosen markets.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a quantitative field
7+ years of professional experience designing, developing, deploying, or supporting machine learning, artificial intelligence, or advanced analytics solutions
3+ years of experience programming in Python, PySpark, PyTorch, and TensorFlow
1+ years of technology consulting experience in the Federal Health space
Active certification in Python, PySpark, PyTorch, or TensorFlow
Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a quantitative field

Secure Third Party Tools team looking for a Senior Applied Scientist with generative AI experience. We seek a hands-on leader and team player who excels in the end-to-end development cycles from research and launch. This leader will conduct applied research and take the resulting models into production. We work in an ambiguous and dynamic space where this leader will need to independently define problems more often than solving pre-scoped problems. Strong candidates will demonstrate the ability to scale themselves by teaching others and simplify complexities.

With the team, you will influence the science roadmap, define model quality measurements, and partner extensively to deliver solutions. Decisions draw on varied, unstructured data in a rapidly changing security landscape. Models need to codify human expertise, detect new issues, and prove approaches, to develop solutions that raise security postures practically, not theoretically.

Key job responsibilities

Set and follow the science direction. Define the research agenda, success metrics, and multi quarter roadmap for applied science in third party security, and present tradeoffs and recommendations to senior leaders.
Automate security decision making. Build machine learning and large language model (LLM) systems that analyze security information and help teams make faster, more consistent third party security decisions.
Build agentic AI workflows. Design agent based and retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems that automate multi step security work and bring in human experts where judgment is needed.
Improve third party risk insight. Develop models that connect information across systems, identify changes in risk over time, and help teams focus on the issues that matter most.
Earn trust in model decisions. Define evaluation methods, benchmarks, and quality controls, and decide when an automated decision is reliable and when it needs expert review.
Raise the team's capability. Mentor scientists and engineers, set best practices for responsible AI in security, and share results through publications and internal forums.

Secure Third Party Tools, part of Amazon Security, builds tools to help evaluate, remediate, and monitor vendor’s security with confidence. Experience in building machine learning models for business application

AI is central to this role. You'll use AI tools every day to work faster and better, and you'll build AI-enabled solutions that create measurable value for clients.

You'll work on hard, open problems with direct investment impact:

Predictive signals from bond time series and unstructured data
A knowledge layer that links issuers, macro themes and market events into structured intelligence.
Autonomous research systems that generate, test and evaluate investment hypotheses on their own.

What you'll do:

Own research end to end: hypothesis, experiment design, validation, overfitting controls and deployment.
Develop ML and deep learning models on large, noisy financial datasets to find and back-test predictive signals.
Build NLP, information extraction and knowledge-graph methods that turn research and news into decision-ready intelligence.
Prototype agentic AI for multi-step research tasks, including reasoning, planning, tool use and memory.
Design benchmarks and evaluation frameworks that make AI-assisted research reliable, grounded and interpretable.
Write production-quality code and partner with investment and technology teams to put models into production.

What you'll bring:

6+ years of hands-on ML/AI research experience. PhD preferred; Master's required.
A track record of taking ML ideas from theory to measurable impact.
Deep expertise in modern ML: transformers, sequence models, representation learning and robust validation.
Hands-on experience and deep expertise with LLMs, agentic systems, retrieval or knowledge graphs, and AI evaluation.
Expert Python skills with modern ML frameworks and sound engineering practices.
The ability to explain complex ideas clearly to investment professionals.

We combine cutting-edge ML with fast, human-relevant lab validation to create biomolecules on demand. We’re hiring a senior engineer to build core infrastructure and tools that connect our AI models to real-world use. You’ll work across the full stack — front-end, back-end, and ML infrastructure — to build systems that close the gap between idea and implementation for our AI and wet-lab scientists. This is a high-impact, hands-on role that directly supports our scientists, collaborators, and pharma partners. You’ll build APIs, dashboards, training and inference pipelines that turn frontier AI models into production-grade tools for drug design. Another focus will be accelerating scientific workflows with LLMs — building systems where AI helps propose and learn from experiments to drive faster cycles of discovery. Build and maintain user-facing applications (UIs, APIs, and dashboards) that reduce the idea-to-implementation gap in drug design workflows
Develop robust ML training and inference systems to accelerate experimentation during model development and expose our models through scalable back-end services
Collaborate closely with scientists to understand pain points and ship high-leverage tools, including AI-augmented experiment planning and analysis
Own full-stack development from prototype to production, including deployment and observability
Leverage modern AI dev tooling to move fast and stay focused on high-value work

Qualifications

5+ years of experience as a full-stack, ML infra, or platform engineer
Experience building backend systems that serve ML models in production
Strong frontend development skills (React, TypeScript, etc.)
Deep fluency in Python; familiarity with cloud-native tools and containerization (Kubernetes, Docker)
Strong product taste, sense, and ability to partner with wet-lab scientists and AI researchers
High agency and a track record of shipping quickly with quality

A fast-moving environment where you can build and ship tools that impact real drug programs
The opportunity to shape how cutting-edge AI and LLMs are used to accelerate scientific discovery
Access to modern ML models and wet-lab infrastructure for rapid experimentation
A small, focused team where your engineering decisions have outsized impact
Highly competitive salary, equity, and benefits package

BroadPeak Investment Group is a private equity and family office firm headquartered in Atlanta building AI-native platforms across its portfolio — property management, franchise operations, sports and entertainment, and more. We are hiring a Senior AI Engineer and Product Lead to own the design, development, and delivery of these systems from the ground up.

This is not a maintenance role. You will be the architect and the builder. You will work directly with the CEO and division leadership to understand what the business needs, translate that into product, and ship it. A junior engineer will support you as your first hire under this role. We use the best tools available. We expect you to know what those tools are, stay ahead of what's coming, and make decisions accordingly.

What you will own:

You are building a property management platform as the first project — a full web application covering tenant management, lease tracking, vendor workflows, maintenance operations, financial reporting, and a public-facing website with AI-powered leasing inquiry. Claude AI is embedded throughout as an operational layer: answering inquiries, drafting communications, analyzing financial performance, handling inbound calls via voice AI, and serving each team member as a role-specific assistant. After Properties, you will replicate and adapt this model across other BroadPeak divisions.

Architect and build full-stack web applications with clean, scalable, maintainable code

Integrate Claude API and other LLM tools deeply into product workflows — not as a chatbot bolted on, but as a core operating layer

Design the AI behavior — prompts, workflows, guardrails, and output quality — so the system performs like a knowledgeable operator

Manage third-party integrations including voice AI (Vapi/Bland.ai), payment processing (Stripe), document management, and financial data

Own the product roadmap, translate business requirements into specifications, and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders

Lead and mentor the junior engineer on your team

Evaluate and adopt new tools continuously — if there is a better way to build something, you find it and use it

What we are looking for:

You have 5 or more years of experience building and shipping production web applications, not prototypes.

You are equally comfortable designing a database schema, writing backend logic, building a clean frontend, and designing the AI workflows that connect everything.

You have shipped something real using Claude, OpenAI, or a comparable LLM API and can walk us through what you built, what broke, and how you fixed it.

You are current. You know what tools exist right now — Cursor, v0, Windsurf, Claude Code, or whatever has emerged since — and you use them to move faster without cutting corners.

You have opinions about the right stack for a given problem and can defend them.

You can sit across from a CEO who does not write code, explain what you are building, take business input, and push back when a requirement does not make sense.

Technical Requirements:

Full-stack proficiency — Python or Node.js backend, React or similar frontend

Database design and management — PostgreSQL preferred

LLM API integration in production — Anthropic Claude strongly preferred; include examples in your application

Cloud deployment and infrastructure — AWS or Vercel

Voice AI platform experience — Vapi, Bland.ai, or equivalent (strong plus)

Multi-tenant application architecture — role-based access, permissioning, security

API integrations — Stripe, DocuSign, or similar third-party services

Proficiency with AI-assisted development environments: Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent

What this is not:

This is not a corporate IT role. There is no existing system to maintain and no committee to approve your stack choices.

You will make decisions and own them. If you need a large team around you to do your best work, this is not the right fit.

Job Summary

The AI Architect designs, develops, and refines secure, cloud-native AI solutions that meet business and technical requirements across manufacturing and the broader enterprise: plant operations as well as finance, HR, commercial, and shared services. This role translates business outcomes into enterprise-architecture-aligned AI solutions, orchestrating contributions across business, IT, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and development teams so AI initiatives deliver measurable business value rather than isolated pilots.

The AI Architect owns the AI data architecture that solutions are built on (embedding pipelines, vector stores, feature stores, and the ontology layer bridging platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, and Fabric) and the cloud reference architectures used to build, host, and run AI on Microsoft Azure. Security, privacy, and responsible AI are designed in from the start. The role is the technical liaison between business stakeholders, data teams, cybersecurity, and technology operations throughout a solution’s life, from data strategy and model or vendor selection through training, rollout, and ongoing monitoring.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Business Alignment & Strategy:

Translate business and technical requirements from manufacturing and back-office functions into architectural blueprints that achieve defined business objectives.
Work with business stakeholders to define clear outcomes, success metrics, and risk tolerance for each AI solution before build begins.
Convert technical performance, cost, and risk into business impact for stakeholders and leadership.

Data & AI Solution Design

Own the AI data architecture (embedding pipelines, vector stores, feature stores) and the ontology layer bridging platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, and Fabric with operational AI platforms.
Develop the data strategy and data management approach for AI model training, testing, and deployment.
Define reusable design patterns for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, tool use, and model serving.
Create architectural designs that guide AI solution development across products, services, projects, and systems.
Partner with data architects, analytics teams, and data scientists to identify and provision the data AI solutions need, applying data classification, lineage, and privacy controls.

Cloud Architecture & AI Platform

Design and maintain cloud reference architectures for AI on Microsoft Azure (for example, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Machine Learning), integrated with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, and Fabric.
Establish standards for AI delivery pipelines (MLOps and LLMOps), including CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Bicep or Terraform), environment separation, and model versioning.
Evaluate infrastructure needs for training, testing, and production, including compute and GPU sizing, scalability, high availability, and disaster recovery.
Design hybrid and edge patterns where plant latency, connectivity, or operational technology (OT) constraints require AI to run near the line.
Set cost guardrails for AI workloads, including budgets, quotas, tagging, and unit-cost tracking per use case, in partnership with cloud operations and finance.
Assess solution requirements and support AI model and vendor selection, including build-versus-buy and hosting trade-offs.

AI Security, Privacy & Responsible AI

Embed secure-by-design principles in every AI solution and partner with Cybersecurity on security architecture reviews before production release.
Perform threat modeling of AI systems against known AI risks such as prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, data or model poisoning, insecure output handling, and excessive agent permissions, using frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.
Define identity and access patterns for AI services and agents using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, and least-privilege access, including permission-aware retrieval so users only see data they are entitled to.
Apply network and data protection controls, including private endpoints, network isolation, encryption, key and secrets management, sensitivity labels, and data loss prevention, to AI data stores, vector stores, and model endpoints.
Define guardrails for enterprise agents (for example, Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry agents), including content safety, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and approved connectors.
Coordinate AI red-teaming and adversarial testing, and integrate AI logging and threat detection with enterprise security monitoring and incident response.
Align AI solutions with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, GPI AI governance policies, and applicable privacy and regulatory requirements; maintain an inventory of AI models, agents, and data sources.
Support third-party AI risk assessments for vendors, models, and AI-enabled SaaS, including data handling, model training use of GPI data, and contract terms.
Apply OT security and network segmentation requirements when AI solutions connect to plant systems.

Monitoring & Operations

Support development of training, testing, and rollout plans for AI solutions.
Develop monitoring plans covering model quality, drift, cost, and security events, and participate in governance to surface problems early.
Define runbooks and support handoffs so production AI solutions are operable by technology operations.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Orchestrate contributions from business, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and IT stakeholders, simplifying collaboration across domains.
Support implementation of AI solution architecture across specific business applications, consistent with enterprise strategy and standards.
Deliver presentations to senior-level executives and technical audiences.
Set the boundary between AI data engineering and AI application engineering so ownership stays unambiguous as the team grows.
Mentor engineers and promote reusable patterns, reference implementations, and architecture decision records.

Required

Minimum 5 years of experience across at least two IT solution development disciplines (infrastructure architecture, application development, cloud development, database management).
At least 2 years working in data architecture, data analytics, or a related domain.
At least 2 years of AI/ML solution design and development experience, with hands-on exposure to embedding pipelines, vector stores, and feature stores sufficient to architect and evaluate AI engineering work directly.
At least 2 years designing production solutions on a major public cloud (Microsoft Azure preferred), including networking, identity, and security controls.
Working knowledge of AI-specific security risks and controls, and of data privacy and protection practices.
Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to both technical and executive audiences.

Experience with AI techniques such as natural language processing, computer vision, and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and model ecosystems such as Hugging Face.

Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Engineer Associate, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, or Azure Security Engineer Associate; data platform certifications (for example, Databricks); or CCSP / CISSP.
Understanding of product management, agile principles, and development methodologies.
Experience with enterprise architecture tools and frameworks.

added.description:
Description

Position Summary

The Risk Modeler III, Model Risk & AI, GenAI Model Validation is responsible for high-quality independent validation of quantitative, machine-learning, generative AI, and agentic AI models and tools. The role assesses whether methodologies, implementation, performance, controls, and monitoring are appropriate for their intended use and comply with Model Risk Management policies, standards, procedures, and applicable regulatory guidance. This role requires advanced technical expertise and minimal supervision to lead complex validations and remain accountable for validation conclusions across a wide range of model categories.

Summary Essential Job Functions

Lead end-to-end validation of generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, and LLM-based models and tools to determine whether they perform effectively and are appropriate for their intended use.
Assess data suitability, conceptual soundness, implementation, robustness, reliability, explainability, human oversight, autonomy, controls, limitations, monitoring, and production readiness.
Design and execute AI-specific testing, including benchmarking, sensitivity and stress testing, stability and drift analysis, hallucination and output-reliability testing, explainability assessments, and evaluation of model limitations.
Independently identify material AI risks, provide credible challenge to Model Development and business stakeholders, and clearly communicate validation conclusions, limitations, and findings to management.
Lead the review and maintenance of relevant model validation documentation, perform in depth analysis on large data sets, and prepare analysis and reports to support discussions on key analytics, model performance and risks.
Enhance the existing GenAI model validation framework by developing standardized performance and reliability metrics.
Stay informed of developments in AI/ML, generative AI, agentic systems, validation methods, regulatory expectations, academia, risk technology, and the financial services industry.
Work closely within the Risk and other relevant functions to validate accuracy and performance of models and to identify issues requiring further investigation.
Support regulatory examinations and internal audits of the modeling process and selected model’s samples.
Continuously drive better model risk management practices and add value to the business through more efficiency, stronger controls, better process, and strong partnership with model stakeholders.
Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.

Position Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computational Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related Quantitative field.
Strong technical knowledge of machine-learning and AI methodologies, with demonstrated ability to evaluate generative AI, large language models, and agentic AI systems.
Demonstrated proficiency in Python and SQL, or comparable analytical tools, for independent testing and validation of statistical, machine-learning, and AI solutions.
Excellent written and communication skills and ability to create and maintain quality model documentation.
Ability to collaborate effectively and follow-up to ensure achievement of deadlines, outcomes, and results.
Effectively communicate model findings to model owners and developers
Ability to work independently and self-motivate in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.

Preferred

Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computational Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related Quantitative field is required, and 4+ years of work-related experience in an analytics role, with a minimum of 3 years of model development/model validation experience in financial services, banking, or retail etc. with 1+ years focused on GenAI and/or agentic AI.
Experience with AI/ML evaluation frameworks and LLM testing tools used to assess generative AI and agentic AI systems.
Experience validating behavioral, credit, fraud, or other financial-services models developed using advanced analytics, machine learning, or AI.
Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and emerging regulatory expectations.
Experience leading complex validation projects, developing actionable plans, and delivering results within established timelines.
Experience supporting regulatory examinations, internal audits, or model-risk governance reviews.
Strong knowledge of current model risk management guidance, including SR 26-2 and OCC Bulletin 2026-13, as well as AI-specific governance and supervisory expectations under the OCC Supervision Intelligence Framework.
Experience in people and project management, including demonstrated ability to develop actionable plans to meet high level objectives, strong execution, and timeline sensitive deliverables.

added.title: Senior AI Research Engineer, Agentic Systems Intelligence
added.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 30 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for outstanding Senior AI Researchers & Engineers to join NVIDIA's Agentic Systems Intelligence (ASI) team, a frontier research and engineering team advancing high-performance AI. Our team builds the next generation of agentic AI systems for the CUDA ecosystem, working across the full stack—from training and improving models, to designing agent architectures and multi-agent systems, to building the systems, runtimes, and evaluation frameworks that make them effective at scale. You will investigate open-ended research questions and turn promising ideas into working systems that can reason about, generate, optimize, and operate across NVIDIA's accelerated computing stack. Depending on your strengths and interests, your work may focus on advancing model and agent capabilities, building scalable agent systems and runtimes, or developing high-fidelity training and evaluation environments. You will own significant parts of these systems end to end and collaborate closely with NVIDIA software, model, and hardware teams to bring new capabilities into NVIDIA products.

What You'll Be Doing

Research, build, and optimize agentic AI systems for the CUDA ecosystem, including agent architectures, multi-agent workflows, tool use, memory, and orchestration.
Build the data pipelines, environments, verification tools, reward mechanisms, and evaluation frameworks needed to continuously improve model and agent capabilities through rigorous experimentation.
Co-design and optimize agentic systems across NVIDIA's software and hardware stack, from models and inference through compilers, runtimes, libraries, kernels, and GPUs. Demonstrate measurable improvements in correctness, performance, or developer productivity.
Take ideas from research prototype to production: own technical directions end to end, set a high bar for rigor, and work with partner teams to deliver them into NVIDIA products.

What We Need To See

Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
6+ years of relevant industry or research experience (including PhD research) in AI systems, agentic AI, machine learning, reinforcement learning, compilers, high-performance computing, or computer architecture.
Hands-on research or development experience in agent systems, coding agents, model training, reinforcement learning, or modern AI inference systems.
Strong Python programming skills and proficiency in C/C++ or Rust, with solid software engineering fundamentals.
Experience with GPU programming and performance optimization using CUDA or comparable accelerator platforms, and the ability to work effectively across system boundaries.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

PhD research in a relevant area, with demonstrated ability to formulate research questions, build working implementations, and evaluate them rigorously.
Track record of building high-impact coding agents, autonomous software-engineering systems, developer tools, or agent training and evaluation environments.
Hands-on experience with GPU performance optimization, or with optimizing and deploying on TRT-LLM, SGLang, vLLM, or Transformer Engine.
Evidence of technical depth and ownership through impactful research prototypes, deployed systems, benchmark results, or substantial open-source contributions. Relevant publications are welcome; we especially value strong engineering and measurable real-world impact.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology industry's most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and hardworking people in the world working with us and our product lines are growing fast in some of the hottest state of the art fields such as Virtual Reality, Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Autonomous Vehicles.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 187,500 USD – 364,000 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 21, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Software Engineer to integrate secure chatbot and AI assistant capabilities into existing geospatial intelligence, analytics, visualization, and mission-support tools. You will help analysts discover data, navigate applications, and complete approved workflows using natural language. The role requires strong software engineering skills, practical LLM experience, and an understanding of secure, usable AI in mission environments.

Responsibilities

Integrate AI chatbots and assistants into existing geospatial, analytics, visualization, and mission applications.
Build natural-language workflows for data discovery, application navigation, visualization generation, and approved actions.
Implement LLM patterns such as prompt orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and conversation context.
Connect AI services to REST APIs, data catalogs, search platforms, knowledge graphs, geospatial services, notebooks, and dashboards.

added.title: Senior/Lead Research Engineer (Foundation Models)
added.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters Labs builds and ships custom models for professional workflows requiring fiduciary-grade AI. The Thomson LLM family was developed by training leading open-weight models on decades of authoritative Thomson Reuters content, with thousands of hours of subject-matter-expert input. Owning the model layer is how we earn trust in the most regulated, highest-stakes professional workflows. See the Thomson 1.0 Technical Report on Hugging Face for more on the latest model release.

Our Research Engineers Build The Systems That Train, Evaluate And Run The Thomson Models, And Work Closely With Research Scientists So That New Algorithms, Rewards And Evaluations Can Be Tested Quickly And At Scale. We Are Hiring At Senior And Lead Level Across Two Areas Of Emphasis. In Your Application, Please Tell Us Which One Fits You Best

Large-scale RL training: architecting and optimising infrastructure for training agentic Mixture-of-Experts models above 300 billion parameters with reinforcement learning, asynchronously and at long context, while the models interact with tools and agent harnesses.
Evaluation engineering: building, scaling and optimising the evaluation suite and leaderboard that run Thomson evaluations as new releases and product integrations arrive.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the systems behind Thomson training, evaluation and experimentation, and keep them reliable as the models and their adoption grow.
Profile and optimise for cost, latency and GPU utilisation without sacrificing quality, and document the trade-offs for the wider team.

Root-cause hard numerical, distributed and performance problems across training frameworks, inference engines and evaluation code.

Work directly with the training and evaluation pods to get new model releases trained, evaluated and live.
Contribute to Thomson's production footing, including the ISO 27001 compliance path.
Set standards for code quality, testing and reproducibility.
At Lead level: own the architecture of your area, plan delivery and staffing with research leads, and mentor engineers.

Required Qualifications

MSc or PhD in computer science, machine learning or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
Strong software engineering practice, including large-scale distributed systems and the ability to work fluently in large open-source codebases.
Experience keeping research or production systems reliable under real load, and debugging distributed systems and incidents.

Experience working closely with researchers and cross-functional stakeholders to turn research ideas and requirements into scalable systems.
Depth in at least one area of emphasis:
Large-scale RL training: multi-node GPU training with PyTorch and Megatron-Core, FSDP/DTensor or DeepSpeed; parallelism strategies (tensor, pipeline, context, expert) and their trade-offs for MoE and long-context models; LLM inference engines (vLLM, SGLang); GPU profiling (memory, NCCL, CUDA graphs).
Evaluation engineering: building, scaling and optimising evaluation suites for LLMs, with examples of the impact your work had.

For Lead level: 3+ years of professional experience in your area and a record of leading complex technical projects end to end and mentoring engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or extending RL post-training frameworks (NeMo-RL, verl, OpenRLHF, TRL), especially asynchronous or non-colocated designs.
Familiarity with evaluation frameworks such as Inspect, Harbor or lm-evaluation-harness.
Experience with distributed runtimes and orchestration (Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm) on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
Significant contributions to vLLM, Megatron, PyTorch or similar open-source projects.
Familiarity with AI-assisted coding and using coding agents at scale.

Even if you don't have all of the above requirements, we encourage you to apply to explore a mutual fit!

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

added.description:
About GoodLeap

GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best-in-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018.

GoodLeap is also proud to support our award-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.

Position Summary

GoodLeap's AI Transformation team partners with business units across the company to enable safe and effective AI adoption through tools, guidance, training, and custom solutions. As a Software Engineer on the team, you will build the AI solutions GoodLeap runs on: AI agents, Claude plugins and skills, evaluation frameworks, and integrations with enterprise systems such as Microsoft 365, Databricks, Okta, and Salesforce.

This role is primarily focused on AI solutions work, with crossover into our Salesforce (SFDC) team — you should expect to periodically pick up Salesforce platform work (integrations, automation, AI features inside SFDC) as business priorities require.

Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities

Build & Ship AI Solutions – Design, build, and maintain AI agents, Claude plugins/skills, evaluation harnesses, and integrations with enterprise systems (Microsoft 365/Graph, Databricks, Okta, SharePoint). Own solutions end-to-end from prototype through production support.
Business Unit Partnership – Work directly with business units in consult and co-develop engagements: gather requirements, prototype quickly, train users, and hand off or maintain solutions.
Salesforce (SFDC) Crossover – Support the Salesforce team as needed: platform integrations, workflow automation, and AI capabilities within the SFDC ecosystem.
Quality & Operations – Write tests and evals, participate in code review, document solutions, and support the tools the team owns.

Required Skills, Knowledge & Abilities

3+ years of professional software engineering experience
Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Python
Experience building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or AI-assisted development tooling (e.g., Claude, MCP, agentic workflows)
Strong API integration skills; comfort working across third-party enterprise systems
Cloud experience (AWS or equivalent)
Exposure to the Salesforce ecosystem (Apex, Flows, SOQL, platform APIs) a plus — willingness to work in it required
Strong communication skills; able to work directly with non-technical business partners
Bias to action; comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration

$106,100 - $145,100 a year

Base pay range (all other US locations) per year: $106,100 - $131,900

added.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Forward Deployment Engineering
added.description:
Description

A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities

Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel.

Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.

Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.

Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.

Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

About The Team

ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years of experience working in an Agile, startup, or rapidly scaling environment
Experience communicating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Experience with agentic and spec-driven development (developing AI agents a plus)
Experience with AI tools: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in customer production environments
Experience building or deploying AI/ML applications in production environments
Background as a founder, engineering lead, or startup builder with high ownership and urgency
Prior experience with React, TypeScript, Python, and/or Go
Experience interfacing with customers or leading technical projects with external stakeholders
Experience working with teams that build and scale end-to-end production systems
Experience with AWS services

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Department Description

At Motorola Solutions, safety and security are at the heart of everything we do, helping people be their best in the moments that matter. Through Priority Intelligence™ and our "Solving for safer" mission, we build AI-assisted technologies that empower human capabilities and protect communities worldwide.

Job Description

Join our engineering team to build, debug, and deploy high-quality language and document generation systems across the full software development lifecycle. In our people-first culture, you will partner across product, design, and engineering teams to translate complex business goals into reliable AI applications.

Responsibilities

Write and debug efficient code for language and document generation systems
Manage assigned development tasks across technical design, coding, testing, and deployment
Collaborate with developers, designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to deliver successful projects
Participate in technical design discussions, providing input on feasibility, estimates, and progress
Identify opportunities to continuously improve engineering workflows and system performance

Specific Knowledge And Skills

Bachelor's Degree

added.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Forward Deployment Engineering
added.description:
Description

A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities

Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel.

Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.

Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.

Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.

Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

About The Team

ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years of experience working in an Agile, startup, or rapidly scaling environment
Experience communicating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Experience with agentic and spec-driven development (developing AI agents a plus)
Experience with AI tools: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in customer production environments
Experience building or deploying AI/ML applications in production environments
Background as a founder, engineering lead, or startup builder with high ownership and urgency
Prior experience with React, TypeScript, Python, and/or Go
Experience interfacing with customers or leading technical projects with external stakeholders
Experience working with teams that build and scale end-to-end production systems

At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Commure, you'll play a crucial role in collaborating directly with healthcare clients, understanding their needs, and actively participating in the design and implementation of customized solutions. This immersive experience offers you the chance to be at the heart of healthcare technology, contributing to projects that enhance patient access, affordability, and care quality.

In this highly visible position, you'll provide essential technical support, tackle various challenges, and maintain vital documentation. Additionally, by keeping pace with evolving healthcare technology trends, you'll contribute innovative ideas and solutions. Your contributions will be instrumental in advancing our mission to revolutionize healthcare through technology.

What You’ll Do

Be willing to travel up to 20% of the time to client site, build on site, and demo.
Participate in the implementation process, aiding in the integration of our solutions into client settings.
Provide technical assistance and contribute to problem-solving during deployment and integration phases.
Work collaboratively with healthcare clients to understand their technology needs, compliance requirements, and patient care goals.
Support our development and engineering teams in crafting tailored solutions for the healthcare industry.
Help identify and address technical challenges encountered during project implementation.
Assist in creating and updating technical documentation to streamline client onboarding and system maintenance.
Keep informed about the latest trends in healthcare technology and regulations to help propose relevant solutions.
Visit new places and meet interesting people in the heart of healthcare

What You Have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
1+ years of professional experience in software engineering or a similar role
Foundational knowledge of full-stack engineering principles and system design.
Experience with programming languages such as Python, Javascript, React, and SQL.
Experience building 0-1 products
Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and effective communication abilities.
Eagerness to collaborate and ability to engage confidently with clients.
Adaptability and enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, client-focused healthcare environment.

commure.com
. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.
