added.title: Agentic Identity Security Consultant
added.description:
We Are

Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond, and recover along with all points of the security lifecycle. Cybersecurity challenges are different for every business in every industry. Leveraging our global resources and advanced technologies, we create integrated, turnkey solutions tailored to our client's needs across their entire value chain. Whether we’re defending against known cyberattacks, detecting and responding to the unknown, or running an entire security operations center, we will help companies build cyber resilience to grow with confidence. Our team of the security sector’s brightest people uses the coolest tech to out-hack the hackers and help clients build resilience from within. We blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security, and managed service solutions to rethink the entire security lifecycle.

Do you have the deep functional and technical experience to help implement security solutions that align with our clients’ business objectives? Do you have the expertise to design and deliver solutions for establishing system user's credentials, and processes for applying those credentials to access enterprise systems and applications?

If so, read on and apply. Accenture’s more than 2,000 security professionals deliver holistic and proactive security solutions in 47 countries, and we’d love to discuss our open Identity and Access Management (I&AM) Security role with you

You Are
An engineer who has stayed an engineer. You came up building things, and you have no interest in a career track that takes that away. You're resourceful about how you get there. You know which problems call for a library, which call for a vendor product, and which call for writing the thing yourself. You read the spec instead of guessing what it says. You've debugged something at 2am because you wanted to know why it broke, not because anyone asked.

You've shipped code that other people depended on and that you were on the hook for when it broke. You go one layer deeper than the assignment required. You can explain a hard technical idea to someone who doesn't share your background without either condescending or hiding behind jargon.

You almost certainly haven't done this specific work before. Very few people have, which is most of why it's interesting.

The Work

The Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic Identity Platform is a hands-on technical role. How much of any given week you spend writing code will vary by engagement, but you'll be expected to understand the systems you work on at implementation depth, and to be able to build in them when the work calls for it. If your recent experience is limited to producing architecture decks, running vendor implementations, or coordinating offshore delivery, this is probably not the right fit, and we would rather tell you now than in the third interview.

Enterprises are deploying AI agents faster than anyone has figured out how to secure them. An agent authenticates to twelve systems, spawns subagents, calls tools on behalf of a user who left the company last month and holds credentials nobody inventoried. The identity primitives that industry spent twenty years building for humans and service accounts don't cleanly extend to actors that are autonomous, ephemeral, and delegating authority to each other.

We're building the platforms that solve this: agent registries, delegated authorization models, runtime attribution, and policy engines that make decisions in single-digit milliseconds. Some of it ships to Fortune 100 clients. Some of it becomes the reference architecture the industry copies. There's no vendor product to install because in several of these areas the product doesn't exist yet.

You'd be a Forward Deployed Engineer, which means you write the code and you're in the room, possibly virtually, with the client while it runs in their environment.

Specifically:

Build and ship services in the agentic identity stack: authorization engines, agent registries, credential brokers, and authentication layers for MCP servers

Own a component end to end: design, implementation, deployment, and what happens when it fails at 3am

Reverse-engineer how identity actually works in a client environment, then design what it should be

Prototype against emerging standards and vendor betas, often before documentation exists

Build the internal tooling and reference implementations the rest of the practice reuses

Explain your design to a client's engineers and defend the parts they push back on

Most people arrive without the identity background, including people who are strong at all of it now. If you have some of it, tell us. If not, we'll teach you, and you'll learn it faster here than anywhere else because you'll be implementing the specs rather than reading about them.

What We'd Like to See

Optional, and not part of how we evaluate candidates. If you'd like to include a link to code you've written, an open-source contribution, or a technical writeup, we enjoy reading them. If your work is under NDA and you'd rather describe in prose what you built, what was hard about it, and what you'd change, that's equally welcome. Applications without either are considered on exactly the same basis.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need

Minimum of 3 years of professional experience building and shipping production software

Hands-on technical work within the last 18 months, counting production development, prototyping, or code review

Minimum of 2 years of professional development in at least one of Python, Go, Rust, TypeScript, Java, or C++

Minimum of 2 years building concurrent or distributed systems that ran in production

Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience deploying and operating cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including containers and CI/CD pipelines

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or equivalent) OR (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Professional Skills Requirements

At least 1 production service or component you owned end to end, covering design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation

Bonus points if you have

Experience with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, token exchange, SAML, SPIFFE, PKI, or mTLS

Experience with MCP, agent frameworks, or LLM application development

Experience in identity and access management, IGA, PAM, secrets management, or non-human identity

Applied cryptography experience, including enough to know what you don't know

Participation in a production on-call rotation

Judgment about which problems call for a library, which call for a vendor product, and which call for writing the thing yourself

Comfort explaining a design to a client's engineers and defending the parts they push back on

added.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Banking and Capital Markets
added.description:
About Chainlink Labs

Chainlink Labs is one of the primary contributing developers of Chainlink, the standard for onchain finance enabling high-quality data, secure cross-chain interoperability, and compliant connectivity across global markets. Chainlink powers leading tokenized assets, financial institutions, market infrastructures, and decentralized applications by providing secure access to real-world data, cross-chain messaging, and blockchain connectivity across any network. The Chainlink standard has enabled tens of trillions of dollars in transaction value and is helping unify global markets onchain. Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, Aave, Polymarket, Lido, and many others.

Chainlink Labs is a world-class team of developers, researchers, and capital markets experts, and has ranked among Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology, Fortune's Best Medium Workplace, and the Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces. Learn more at chain.link or chainlinklabs.com.

About The Role

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will play a crucial role in driving the adoption of Chainlink products across the capital markets industry as we continue to expand our presence there.

You will work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to evangelise Chainlink technology across the finance industry and work directly with technical teams at major institutions to gather requirements, scope projects and deliver innovative solutions that address the complex needs of their stakeholders. You will also work directly with internal teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering and Legal and make a significant contribution to the ongoing development of the Chainlink capital markets product strategy.

Your Impact

Drive the successful adoption of Chainlink products in the capital markets industry by establishing strong relationships with key stakeholders, including major financial institutions, and providing technical expertise and guidance throughout the sales and implementation process
Lead and actively participate in gathering requirements, scoping projects, and designing innovative solutions that leverage Chainlink products to address specific use cases and challenges within the capital markets industry
Contribute significantly to the development of the Chainlink capital markets product strategy by providing valuable insights, market feedback, and technical expertise, thereby influencing the direction and roadmap of the product suite
Collaborate closely with internal technical teams, including developers and engineers, to provide feedback and guidance on product enhancements, bug fixes, and new feature development, ensuring that the capital markets requirements are effectively addressed
Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the capital markets industry, including market trends, challenges, and emerging technologies, to effectively position and promote Chainlink products

Requirements

Technical pre/postsales technology experience, working with major institutions within capital markets or payment
Experience with, and strong knowledge of blockchain technology and associated areas (e.g. DeFi, tokenisation / digital assets, digital identity, etc.)
Hands-on experience with middleware, integration architecture patterns, web services technologies, and APIs
Experience building and delivering Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and responding to functional and technical elements of proposals independently,
Respond independently and effectively to RFIs, RFPs, and Due Diligence Questionnaires (DDQs) — covering functional, technical, security, and compliance dimensions
Build and deliver bespoke Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and prototype integrations that demonstrate viability within the customer's existing technology stack
Contribute to and maintain a library of reference architectures, solution accelerators, and technical decision guides for use across the solutions team

Preferred Requirements

Experience in any of the following: Solidity, Golang, Rust, JS, Java, Python, C/C++
Experience in networking protocols, private IP environments, cloud infrastructure, and the implementation of SSL/TLS security measures
Knowledge of capital markets concepts, financial instruments and trading processes, including Corporate actions, PMS, OMS, Exchanges, FMIs, Clearing houses, etc.
Experience with permissioned blockchain and public blockchains with familiarity with decentralised oracle design, data feed mechanisms, proof-of-reserve systems, or cross-chain messaging protocols
Prior involvement in Digital Assets design, tokenised collateral programs, or digital securities issuance platforms at a regulated financial institution or central bank
Experience as a technical author — published white papers, reference architectures, or standards contributions in blockchain, fintech, or capital markets
Certifications in AWS / Azure / GCP (Solutions Architect level or above), TOGAF, etc.

Chainlink Labs is a remote-first organization and employment eligibility is contingent upon residing in an approved hiring jurisdiction. Team members may work outside their primary country of legal residence for a maximum of 90 days per calendar year. Please discuss your current location, legal residence, and work authorization with your recruiter during your initial conversation. Unless otherwise stated for a specific role, we require working hours that overlap with Eastern Time (ET).

added.title: Senior Solutions Architect – Robotics Embedded Systems and Safety
added.description:
Physical AI is expanding what robots can do, and bringing these capabilities into production demands reliable integration of AI, sensing, control, and safety. We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Solutions Architect to help customers design and deploy the embedded platforms powering the next generation of robots. This role connects system architecture with hardware bring-up, sensor integration, and robotics AI deployment. You’ll work with customers and NVIDIA Engineering, Product, and ecosystem teams to turn prototypes into production-ready robotics systems.

The ideal candidate brings strong system-level thinking, embedded engineering depth, and the curiosity to work across the full robotics platform. Are you are passionate about Robotics and ready to make a meaningful difference? If so, this role fits you!

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead customer architecture engagements and design reviews, translating application requirements into robotics system designs that balance performance, power, reliability, and safety.
Design system architectures integrating robot foundation models with real-time control and safety subsystems, addressing workload placement, partitioning, isolation, and time synchronization.
Bring up and debug embedded robotics platforms alongside customers. Integrate sensors, operating systems, middleware, and runtimes, and build proofs of concept to validate designs.
Guide customer integration of NVIDIA Halos for Robotics. Work with safety engineers and certification teams to define system boundaries, interfaces, and platform requirements aligned with the customer’s safety architecture.
Profile and optimize robotics workloads across CPUs, GPUs and distributed onboard compute, resolving bottlenecks in scheduling, memory, communication and resource contention.
Develop reference architectures, integration guides, and technical workshops. Mentor other Solutions Architects and translate customer feedback into product improvements.

What We Need To See

BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in embedded systems, robotics platforms, or systems software, with demonstrated technical leadership and ownership of complex integrations.
Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson, or comparable embedded platforms, including Linux development, platform bring-up, and debugging across hardware and software boundaries.
Experience developing robotics systems with ROS 2 or similar middleware, with strong fundamentals in concurrency, scheduling, memory, I/O, and networking.
Experience integrating, deploying, and optimizing robotics perception and deep learning inference pipelines on embedded platforms (TensorRT, CUDA, Nsight), with proficiency in C++ and/or Python.
Experience with real-time, safety-aware embedded systems and working knowledge of standards such as IEC 61508 or ISO 13849. Ability to collaborate with safety engineers and certification teams.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, showing aptitude for leading technical discussions, explaining tradeoffs, and resolving issues across customer and internal engineering teams.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience bringing robotics platforms into production using NVIDIA Isaac OS, Isaac ROS, Holoscan Sensor Bridge, or Halos.
Familiarity with QNX or other RTOS environments, hypervisors, or safety MCU integration in systems combining safety-critical and AI workloads.
Experience with embedded Linux distributions, BSP customization, containerized deployment, secure boot, and OTA updates.
Expertise in camera and sensor integration, including V4L2, GMSL, ISP tuning, synchronization, or high-throughput processing.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

187,500 USD – 364,000 USD for Level 4; and 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

added.title: Data Scientist - National Federal Tax Services
added.description:
Our Global Investment and Innovation Incentives ("Gi3") practice provides our clients a broad range of government credits and incentives ("C&I") services across more than 150 countries and regions worldwide. With over 1,000 practitioners, the Gi3 tax team is a national team of specialists dedicated to providing comprehensive tax C&I services.

If you are a technology visionary with a passion for transforming global tax business with digital technology, consider working with the Gi3 technology team. This is an exciting opportunity to support global execution of Deloitte's tax strategy as we shift from "doing digital" to "being digital" by reimagining how we engage with our clients, deliver our services, operate our business, and create value.

Work you'll do

U.S. Soccer Overview

The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good.

We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S.

U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitious plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results.

Position Description

U.S. Soccer is seeking a Data Scientist to help transform data into actionable insights, intelligent products, and measurable business outcomes. The Data Scientist will join the Business Ventures team, advancing data-driven decision-making across the Federation, working with stakeholders throughout Commercial, Marketing, Ticketing, Membership, E-commerce, Advancement, Product, and Technology to identify where analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and artificial intelligence can improve performance and accelerate growth.

This is not a reporting role. The Data Scientist will take ownership of complex business problems, translate them into analytical frameworks, and work with partners to put those solutions into practice. Projects may include understanding what drives soccer fandom in the United States, forecasting demand for matches and products, predicting fan behavior, improving audience segmentation, measuring campaign effectiveness, developing customer intelligence, and building AI-powered tools that make data more accessible across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical capabilities with curiosity, business judgment, and communication skills. They should be comfortable working with large and sometimes imperfect datasets, able to explain complex findings to nontechnical audiences, and genuinely interested in what creates and sustains a soccer fan—why someone attends a match, tunes in, buys a jersey, or brings a child into the game.

Primary Responsibilities

Predictive Modeling and Machine Learning

Develop, validate, and deploy predictive models supporting fan engagement, ticket sales, membership growth, retention, e-commerce, fundraising, and marketing—including propensity, classification, forecasting, segmentation, recommendation, and customer-value models.
Develop a deep understanding of what drives soccer fandom in the United States: how fans discover the sport, what converts casual interest into attendance, viewership, and purchase, and how those drivers differ across markets, teams, and competitions.
Forecast demand for matches, broadcasts, and products, and isolate the primary drivers behind changes in attendance, viewership, and revenue so stakeholders understand not just what is projected, but why.
Select appropriate statistical and machine-learning methods based on the business problem, available data, and intended use of the results.
Establish model evaluation, monitoring, documentation, and regression-testing processes so solutions remain reliable over time.
Develop audience segments and analytical frameworks that improve personalization, targeting, acquisition, retention, and lifetime value, and evaluate customer journeys to deepen relationships with current supporters and reach new soccer audiences.
Partner with Marketing, CRM, and other stakeholders to embed model outputs into campaigns, platforms, and lifecycle strategies.
Identify opportunities to responsibly apply generative AI, natural-language interfaces, and intelligent automation, and contribute to AI-powered tools that help employees answer their own questions.

Communication and Cross-Functional Partnership

Work directly with stakeholders to translate broad or ambiguous business questions into clearly defined analytical problems.
Present findings and recommendations clearly and compellingly to both technical and nontechnical audiences, and create visualizations and decision-support materials that make complex analysis actionable.
Build strong relationships across departments and serve as a trusted analytical partner.

Join us to turn scientific discovery into security breakthroughs that help people build and use AI with greater confidence.

We’re looking for Deep Learning Scientist to join our AI Security and Responsibility efforts. You’ll advance security alignment for large language models and develop guardrails that help the systems they power resist adversarial manipulation and operate within trusted boundaries. NVIDIA’s work creates opportunities to carry new ideas from experiments into practice. If you’re driven to explore how powerful systems can fail and determined to make them stronger, bring that curiosity and persistence to Nvidia.

What You Will Be Doing

Apply fundamental and applied security research to develop, train, fine-tune, and deploy large language models for multimodal agentic reasoning systems and guardrails encompassing text, audio, image, video, and tool usage.
Advance post-training and alignment methods including instruction tuning, preference optimization, and RLHF/RLVR/MOPD to improve security of multimodal agents for complex use cases.
Model and System Security: Research and deploy techniques beyond post-training, such as instruction hierarchy, risk detection, and new cyber gyms.
Lead the collection, development, and benchmarking of multimodal security datasets, ensuring high-quality evaluation of model accuracy, safety, and task completion success.
Partner with engineers, data scientists, research teams, and product managers across NVIDIA to scale solutions for LLM security and agentic safety.

What We Need To See

Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) or PhD in Computer Science, AI, or Applied Math with 8+ years of relevant work experience.
Excellent programming skills in Python with strong fundamentals in scalable model development and deep learning frameworks like PyTorch.
Strong knowledge of ML/DL techniques and modern foundation model architectures, including Transformers and mixture-of-experts models.

added.title: Senior Data Scientist
added.description:
A Note From the Founder

Citizen makes thousands of decisions a day about what people see, when they are alerted, and what we build next. Every one of those decisions leaves a trail in our data: what people opened, what they followed, what kept them coming back. Few companies get to learn from a dataset like this, about moments that matter this much. I want a data scientist who loves that problem: someone who designs great experiments, finds the signal in real-world data, and helps decide what we build next, with AI tools that let one person cover more ground than a whole analytics team could a few years ago. If you want your work to shape what a city sees in the moments that matter most, come build it with us.

The Role

Citizen is the #1 safety app in the U.S. Every day, thousands of videos are captured live at the scene of real incidents and distributed in real time to people in every major American city. No other consumer product has this. It is a live network, a newsroom, and a safety tool at once, and it is growing again.

Underneath it is one of the most unusual datasets in consumer technology: a decade of incidents, live user video with location, every alert we have sent, and how millions of people respond to it, all instrumented as analytics events in BigQuery. As our senior data scientist, you will lead what we learn from that data: the experiments that decide what ships, the analysis that answers product questions, and the recommendation for what to try next.

You will work with a small, fast team across product, engineering, and operations. You will partner closely with the engineers shipping changes, Mission Control, and the Founder.

Why Now

Citizen is moving faster than at any point in its history. We are building AI into how incidents are written, who gets alerted and at what radius, and how people find and follow what is happening near them. Every one of those changes is a bet worth measuring well, and this role makes sure we learn from each one. It is also a great moment to be a data scientist: AI tools now handle much of the querying, segmenting, and first-draft analysis, so your time goes to the parts that need real judgment.

How We Work

You are a data scientist first: statistical judgment, rigor about what a number means, and healthy skepticism of a result that looks too good. Alongside that, you use AI tools and agents to write queries, build pipelines, and draft analyses, so you spend your time on the questions and the conclusions rather than the plumbing.

Engineering runs on a driver and builder model. Every initiative has one accountable driver who owns scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs, and a small set of builders who ship it with them. Drivers are chosen by who wants the ownership, not by seniority. You will contribute to other people's initiatives and lead your own early on.

What You Will Own

Experimentation.
Our experimentation framework and the practice around it: hypothesis, assignment, power, sample size, and guardrail metrics; sample-ratio checks, variance reduction, novelty and seasonality effects, and segment effects; a clear readout format and cadence. Product, notification, and content changes that reach millions of people run through it.

Product analytics.
The event model end to end, from Segment to BigQuery. Funnels, retention, engagement, and behavior by city and incident type. Answering the questions the team asks, and surfacing the ones it should be asking.

Turning results into decisions.
Every readout ends with a recommendation: what the result means for users, what to build or test next, and what to stop.

Notifications and relevance.
Who gets alerted, at what radius, for what. Notifications are the product's most powerful lever. You will own how they are measured and the experiments that improve them.

Core metrics.
Partnering with the data team on the definitions behind the metrics leadership and the board use, and on the monitoring that keeps them reliable.

Measuring AI features.
Partnering with ML and engineering on how we evaluate AI in the product from the user's side: what good looks like, and whether a change made the experience better.

Product visualization.
Finding the few metrics that matter among many, and building clean, readable views of product health and experiment results that anyone in the company understands at a glance.

Analysis tooling
. Extending the AI tools and agents we use to query, segment, and draft analysis, so the answer to a product question takes hours, not weeks.

Your First 30 Days

Days 1–10. Learn the product (use it every day in New York), the event model, and our metrics. Rebuild one core product metric from raw events and review a recent A/B test and its readout.
Days 11–20. Ship your first analysis that informs a product decision. Start your first initiative: strengthen the experimentation framework (design template, power checks, guardrails, readout format) and launch one test through it.
Days 21–30. Deliver your first readout with a recommendation, and present an experimentation plan for the next two quarters: the questions that matter most, the tests that answer them, and the metrics you plan to move.

How Success Is Measured

Experiments run per quarter, and the share whose readout leads to a decision
Results the team trusts: pre-registered metrics, clean assignment, and wins that hold up over time
Time from product question to answer, shrinking as AI tooling takes on more of the work
Notification relevance: opens, dismissals, and opt-outs per alert improving together
Clear metric definitions and event coverage across the core product

Required

What You Bring

5+ years in data science, product analytics, or experimentation, with at least 3 years on a consumer product at scale (millions of users)
A degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. An MS or PhD is welcome, not required.
Hands-on experience designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests: power and sample size, guardrail metrics, sample-ratio checks, and the common pitfalls (peeking, novelty effects, interference)
Strong applied statistics: regression, hypothesis testing, variance reduction (e.g. CUPED), and causal inference methods for when a clean test is not possible (difference-in-differences, matching, synthetic control)
Expert SQL and strong Python (pandas, NumPy, statsmodels or SciPy) in a modern cloud warehouse; we use BigQuery and Segment
A strong eye for data visualization: you can take a crowded set of metrics and turn it into a clean, readable chart that anyone on the team understands
A track record of analysis that changed what a product team built, and the communication skills to make that happen: clear written readouts and confident presentation to engineers and executives
Day-to-day use of AI tools in your own analytical workflow (e.g. LLM-assisted SQL and Python, agents for recurring analysis)

Preferred

Experience with notifications, ranking, recommendations, or other relevance problems
Experience with geospatial or location-based data
Experience with an experimentation platform (e.g. GrowthBook, Statsig, Optimizely, Eppo) or building one
Familiarity with event instrumentation and data modeling (dbt, event taxonomies, data quality monitoring)
Experience evaluating ML or LLM-powered product features from a user-outcome perspective
Consumer, media, or real-time product experience

Who You Are

Curious. Handed a question, you often come back with a better one.
Rigorous and practical: you know when a result is solid and when it needs another look, and you can explain why.
An owner who likes leading initiatives as well as contributing to them.
Motivated by the mission. Safety matters to real people in real moments, and you want your work to contribute.
Excited to work in person with the team in our New York office.

Compensation

$200,000 - $240,000 base, plus equity

added.title: Computer Vision Engineer
added.description:
About Powerus

Powerus is building a next-generation American autonomous systems platform designed to move, protect, and sustain critical assets in high-consequence environments. The company combines advanced autonomy, manufacturing capability, operational expertise, and strategic acquisitions to support defense, national security, critical infrastructure, and commercial operations globally.

Mission

Our mission is to deliver resilient autonomous technologies that strengthen national security, improve operational safety, and expand the capabilities of organizations operating in complex environments.

Why Join Powerus

Powerus aircraft carry electro-optical and infrared cameras that operators use to find, identify, and follow objects of interest. The processing that turns those images into detections and tracks runs on the aircraft, within tight limits on compute, power, and latency.

This role develops and deploys the vision algorithms that run onboard, and verifies them against real flight imagery across lighting, weather, and sensor conditions.

Position Overview

Powerus is seeking a Computer Vision Engineer to develop onboard detection, tracking, and image processing for EO/IR sensors on autonomous aircraft.

Key Responsibilities

Develop object detection, multi-object tracking, and target re-acquisition for EO and IR imagery
Implement image stabilization, registration, and geolocation of detections
Optimize vision pipelines for embedded GPUs and accelerators
Integrate vision outputs with autonomy, payload control, and ground station displays
Evaluate algorithm performance on recorded flight data and define acceptance metrics
Support flight test and data collection

Qualifications

Must be located in the United States, within commuting distance of Rock Hill, SC
Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
Professional experience developing computer vision software in C++ and Python
Experience with OpenCV and a deep learning framework such as PyTorch
Experience with object detection and tracking algorithms
Working knowledge of camera models, calibration, and multi-view geometry
Experience deploying vision software on embedded or real-time systems
U.S. Person status required (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)); this role involves access to ITAR- and EAR-controlled technical data

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT, or CUDA
Experience with infrared imagery
Experience with aerial or overhead imagery
Graduate degree in computer vision, robotics, or a related field
Active or prior U.S. security clearance

What We Look For

Candidates should have deployed a vision algorithm on hardware that operated outside a lab and be able to describe how its performance was measured.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Powerus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and mission-driven workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

added.description:
Description

Do you want to help digital native ecommerce companies transform their businesses with cloud and AI technologies? Amazon Web Services (AWS) Global Sales is seeking a Solutions Architect III to join our Digital Native team, working with innovative ecommerce enterprises navigating complex cloud adoption and AI transformation journeys.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to fast-growing digital commerce companies, representing the full breadth of AWS services. You will architect scalable, resilient cloud solutions that enable customers to leverage data analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to enhance customer experiences, optimize operations, and accelerate growth. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and AI innovation, helping some of the most dynamic companies in ecommerce achieve competitive advantage through technology.

Key job responsibilities

Design and architect end-to-end cloud solutions for digital native ecommerce customers, addressing complex technical challenges in data platforms, analytics pipelines, AI/ML workloads, and application modernization
Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture design reviews, and Well-Architected Reviews with customer engineering teams to ensure solutions follow cloud best practices for security, reliability, performance, and cost optimization
Drive customer success by providing strategic technical guidance on AI adoption, helping customers implement machine learning models, generative AI capabilities, and data-driven personalization to enhance their customer experiences and business outcomes
Collaborate with AWS service teams, Professional Services, and partner organizations to deliver innovative solutions, prototype new approaches, and remove technical blockers for customer implementations
Create and share technical thought leadership through reference architectures, blog posts, workshops, and presentations that enable broader adoption of AWS solutions in the ecommerce industry

A day in the life

You will engage deeply with customer engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges focused on data and AI. Your days include whiteboarding scalable architecture designs, conducting technical deep dives on AWS AI services, reviewing customer implementations for optimization opportunities, and collaborating with internal teams to prototype innovative solutions. You will balance strategic conversations about cloud transformation roadmaps with hands-on technical work, such as designing data lake architectures or architecting real-time ML inference pipelines for recommendation engines.

About The Team

Join the AWS RRCG team, where we partner with innovative ecommerce companies that are redefining commerce experiences. Our team works with high-growth technology companies operating at significant scale, serving millions of customers and processing vast amounts of transactional data.

We foster a culture of technical excellence and customer obsession, where you will collaborate with talented solutions architects, specialists, and technical leaders who are passionate about helping customers innovate. You will have opportunities to deepen your expertise in emerging technologies like generative AI, machine learning, and cloud-native architectures while making meaningful impact on customer businesses.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
2+ years of technology/software sales experience

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
Experience working with end user or developer communities
Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals

added.title: Principal, AI Transformation – Revenue & GTM
added.description:
About Formlabs

A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build.

Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem.

That’s what we do.

At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA.

Your Impact

As the Principal, AI Transformation – Revenue & GTM
at Formlabs, you will lead how our Sales, Services, and Go-To-Market teams use AI to find, win, grow, and keep customers. This is a hands-on role. You will set the strategy, and you will personally build, ship, and measure the workflows and agents that change how our commercial teams work every day.

You will partner closely with our Chief Revenue Officer, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and the Systems team, which enables every Formlabs team with enterprise applications, infrastructure, data, AI, and security.

The Job

Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive a multi-year AI transformation roadmap for Revenue and GTM, prioritized by impact on pipeline, win rate, deal velocity, retention, and cost to serve. Explain it in business terms to the CRO, CFO, and company leadership.
Build & Ship: Personally design, prototype, and deploy AI agents and workflows across the funnel: account research and prospecting, lead scoring and routing, outbound personalization, call preparation and summaries, quoting, forecasting, renewal and expansion signals, and support deflection.
Sales & Channel Enablement: Equip our direct sales team and global reseller network with AI tools that help them understand customer applications, recommend the right printers and materials, and move faster from first conversation to purchase order.
Marketing & Growth: Partner with Marketing to apply AI to content creation and localization, campaign targeting, SEO and web experience, and ecommerce conversion.
Customer Success & Services: Work with Customer Service and Technical Support to use AI for ticket triage, knowledge management, and proactive customer health monitoring.
Data Foundation: Partner with Revenue Operations, Data Engineering, and Systems to make sure our CRM and customer data are clean, connected, and ready for AI. Make clear build/buy/partner decisions across the GTM tech stack.
Adoption & Change Management: Drive real usage, not just pilots. Train and coach teams, build a network of AI champions, and redesign processes and roles where AI changes the work.
Measurement: Set baselines and track outcomes for every initiative: hours saved, pipeline created, conversion lift, forecast accuracy, and ROI. Report progress to leadership on a regular cadence.
Governance & Responsible AI: With Legal, Security, and IT, set practical guardrails for data privacy, customer data, brand voice, and model use globally.

You

Experience: 5+ years across Revenue Operations, Sales or Marketing Operations, GTM strategy, or GTM systems, including 2+ years leading AI, automation, or digital transformation programs for commercial teams.
Proven Results: A track record of taking AI or automation from pilot to wide adoption, with measurable impact on revenue, productivity, or customer experience.
Hands-On Builder: You can build it yourself. Practical experience with LLMs, prompt and agent design, and workflow automation tools; you can prototype a working agent in days, not quarters.
GTM Systems Depth: Strong working knowledge of CRM (Salesforce or similar), marketing automation, conversation intelligence, and how data flows across the funnel.
Business Acumen: You understand B2B sales motions (direct, inside sales, channel, and ecommerce), and can tie every initiative to a revenue or cost outcome.
Change Leadership: You know how to win over skeptical sellers and managers, and you measure adoption as rigorously as you measure output.
Communication: You translate technical options into clear business decisions for executives, and write clear plans, playbooks, and recommendations.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Bonus Skills

Experience in a hardware, manufacturing, or other technical B2B company with a global reseller channel.
Scripting or development skills (Python, SQL, APIs) and experience with tools such as Salesforce Agentforce, Gong, Clay, HubSpot, Zapier, n8n, or similar.
Experience operating across the US, Europe, and Asia Pacific, including EU data privacy requirements.
Background in sales, solutions engineering, or consulting before moving into operations or AI.
Passion for tech and/or 3D printing

Our Benefits & Perks

Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs
Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
401K matching and access to financial advisors
Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)
Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)
Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it
Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits
Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats
Regular sponsored professional development opportunities
Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community
And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply.
Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here. Please give them a read.

Compensation

Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.

Base pay is the other part of our compensation package, and it is carefully determined based on your skills, experience, and expected impact. Equity and base pay combine to make up your total compensation package at Formlabs.

The Annual Base Pay Range For This Role Is

$125,000—$200,000 USD

Description

Do you want to help digital native ecommerce companies transform their businesses with cloud and AI technologies? Amazon Web Services (AWS) Global Sales is seeking a Solutions Architect III to join our Digital Native team, working with innovative ecommerce enterprises navigating complex cloud adoption and AI transformation journeys.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to fast-growing digital commerce companies, representing the full breadth of AWS services. You will architect scalable, resilient cloud solutions that enable customers to leverage data analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to enhance customer experiences, optimize operations, and accelerate growth. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and AI innovation, helping some of the most dynamic companies in ecommerce achieve competitive advantage through technology.

Key job responsibilities

Design and architect end-to-end cloud solutions for digital native ecommerce customers, addressing complex technical challenges in data platforms, analytics pipelines, AI/ML workloads, and application modernization
Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture design reviews, and Well-Architected Reviews with customer engineering teams to ensure solutions follow cloud best practices for security, reliability, performance, and cost optimization
Drive customer success by providing strategic technical guidance on AI adoption, helping customers implement machine learning models, generative AI capabilities, and data-driven personalization to enhance their customer experiences and business outcomes
Collaborate with AWS service teams, Professional Services, and partner organizations to deliver innovative solutions, prototype new approaches, and remove technical blockers for customer implementations
Create and share technical thought leadership through reference architectures, blog posts, workshops, and presentations that enable broader adoption of AWS solutions in the ecommerce industry

A day in the life

You will engage deeply with customer engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges focused on data and AI. Your days include whiteboarding scalable architecture designs, conducting technical deep dives on AWS AI services, reviewing customer implementations for optimization opportunities, and collaborating with internal teams to prototype innovative solutions. You will balance strategic conversations about cloud transformation roadmaps with hands-on technical work, such as designing data lake architectures or architecting real-time ML inference pipelines for recommendation engines.

Join the AWS RRCG team, where we partner with innovative ecommerce companies that are redefining commerce experiences. Our team works with high-growth technology companies operating at significant scale, serving millions of customers and processing vast amounts of transactional data.

We foster a culture of technical excellence and customer obsession, where you will collaborate with talented solutions architects, specialists, and technical leaders who are passionate about helping customers innovate. You will have opportunities to deepen your expertise in emerging technologies like generative AI, machine learning, and cloud-native architectures while making meaningful impact on customer businesses.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
